main_body: A stretched tan hide with teal painted patterns, held in a wooden frame with a front bottom beam and two short legs, all seen face-on
top_band: none. At the top (rows 0-2) there is only a thin dark brown frame rim of about 2px. The only lighter brown band is the bottom beam at rows 17-19, and it reads as a front face rather than a surface seen from above.
evidence: Reading a column down the middle, I see a 1-2px dark brown rim at the top, then straight into the vertical tan hide from row 3 to 16 with no horizontal surface. The bottom beam at rows 17-20 is a flat brown band the same tone as the frame sides, with no lighter top face and no front-edge step. The side posts are thin vertical strips and the legs are short stubs. The hide is painted flat on the frame, not inset or set back. This matches the red front-elevation and rim-only examples in the guide, so it fails.

style.evidence: The outline is dark brown beside the wood and the hide, so it is not a black sticker line. The hide has about 4 tones (light ochre, mid ochre, dark ochre shadow, teal pattern) plus some speckle, and the frame wood has roughly 3 steps. That is fewer than the 5-6 steps in the stall and well references. Large patches of the hide are a single flat ochre, the bottom beam is a flat brown band, and the legs are plain. Overall it reads thinner and flatter than the references.
